name: Paliperidone
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Renal excretion of unchanged drug is the main elimination route. CYP2D6/CYP3A4 show activity in vitro but contribute little to overall in-vivo clearance. Paliperidone is also risperidone's active 9-hydroxy metabolite.
